name: GDGROUP
recent: GDGROUP 于 2026 年 9 月 17 日召开特别股东大会，两项拟议收购（Proposed Acquisition 1 与 Proposed Acquisition 2）的普通决议均以 100% 赞成票通过。公司于 9 月 2 日向股东发出相关通函，并在 8 月下旬出现董事及大股东在公开市场增持股份的申报。
notable: 特别股东大会通过两项拟议收购（Proposed Acquisition 1 与 Proposed Acquisition 2）。
董事总经理 Lim Swee Kok 与首席运营官 Charles Lim Yong Zhao 于 8 月 19 日至 20 日在公开市场增持公司股份。

ann.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE FOLLOWING:- (I) PROPOSED ACQUISITION 1; AND (II) PROPOSED ACQUISITION 2, (COLLECTIVELY REFERRED TO AS THE "PROPOSALS")

recent_en: GDGROUP held an EGM on 17 September 2026, where both ordinary resolutions for Proposed Acquisition 1 and Proposed Acquisition 2 were passed with 100% votes in favour. The company issued a circular to shareholders on 2 September, and filings in late August showed acquisitions of shares by a director and a substantial shareholder.
notable_en: The EGM approved both Proposed Acquisition 1 and Proposed Acquisition 2.
Managing Director Lim Swee Kok and COO Charles Lim Yong Zhao acquired shares in the open market on 19-20 August.
